words.example: Please follow through on the promise.
Keep me posted on the delay.
words.exampleZh: 延误情况请随时告诉我。

words.example: Are we on the same page now?
The bottom line is that we need another clerk at Monday registration.
words.exampleZh: 关键结论是，周一挂号处还得再加一名文员。

words.example: SSO (Single Sign-On) failed, so nurses had to type a password into every system.
words.exampleZh: SSO（单点登录）失败了，护士只好在每个系统里手输密码。

words.meaning: 目录访问协议（Lightweight Directory Access Protocol）
words.example: LDAP (Lightweight Directory Access Protocol) timed out when the clinic tried to sign in.
words.exampleZh: 门诊登录时，LDAP（目录访问协议）超时了。

words.example: Active Directory locked the shared pharmacy account after repeated failures.
words.exampleZh: 反复失败之后，活动目录锁住了药房的共用账号。

words.meaning: 基于角色的权限（Role-Based Access Control）
words.example: RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) keeps interns from signing medication orders.
words.exampleZh: RBAC（基于角色的权限）不让实习生签署用药医嘱。

words.meaning: 访问控制列表（Access Control List）
words.example: ACL (Access Control List) on the consent folder blocks the night clerks.
words.exampleZh: 知情同意文件夹上的ACL（访问控制列表）把夜班文员挡住了。
